opening.argument: The activity described is an ordinary Shopkick rewards-app demonstration built around store visits, product scans, referrals, and the speaker's own points goal. The participation method is concrete: “All you have to do is either walk into the store or scan specific products.” The video also shows a scan-based offer, while the speaker explains that reaching a personal daily target could produce a gift card each month. The free Target gift-card framing and referral code promote the app, but they do not change the underlying shopping-and-rewards flow. The speaker further states that the post is not sponsored, supporting an explanation of personal app use rather than a deceptive promise of guaranteed results.

citations.quote: All you have to do is either walk into the store or scan specific products.
